# Policy rewrites (Matt, 3 Nov 2026: pushed history is never rewritten): each upstream sentence that says to force-push is
# replaced with the merge-based step. test/no-force-push.test.mjs fails if a rendered skill still says it, e.g. after a pin bump.
Force-push only your own branch, with `--force-with-lease` pinned to the SHA you last pushed or took over, and on any push you did not make, stop and report to the root.
column2: Never rewrite a pushed branch (eng-standard SHIPPING.md rule 1): every fix is a new commit, the base comes in by merge (`gh pr update-branch <n>`), and on any push you did not make, stop and report to the root.

column1: Where this playbook says to report a rebase, that owner rebases its own branch and publishes it with `git push --force-with-lease` per `playbooks/autopilot-full.md` step 2.
column2: Where this playbook says to report a rebase, that owner brings the base in with a merge (`gh pr update-branch <n>`) and pushes a new commit. Pushed history is never rewritten (eng-standard SHIPPING.md rule 1).
